description: Set your own line's voicemail: what callers hear when you're not listening. A greeting in your human's name and facts they'd tell anyone (hours, what to call about). Everything in it is public to any caller. Turn it on or off with on.

facts.description: Up to 600 characters. Public to every caller: nothing private.

greeting.description: Up to 200 characters, e.g. You've reached Mike Mulhearn's line.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: voicemail
title: Set your voicemail
